notes.title: Patch 1.1.3 is out!
notes.notes:
Dear friends! 👋  



Here comes the latest round of patches addressing some edge case fixes and overall improvements. Huge thanks for keeping your feedback coming! You are awesome! 🚀  
[hr][/hr]
🛠️ Here's a summary of what's included in patch 1.1.3: 

Audio mixing fixes

Art layering fixes

Fixed item comment inconsistencies on Fuxia

Fixed some typos

Fixed a chapter number inconsistency

Fixed a rare bug that caused an unintended state with the digsite

Fixed Elroy's eyes becoming stuck looking up

Fixed the theater script from preventing saving after closing it

[hr][/hr]
We're working on possible improvements all the time, so keep an eye out for future patches!  And please keep your feedback coming in Elroy's Steam Discussions forum! 🤝

Love,

- Team Elroy

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is out!
notes.notes:
Desayák! 👋

We're humbled by the super positive response we have received since the release! 🙏

Huge thanks to everyone for playing and for sharing your impressions with us.

Meanwhile, we've been busy testing and fixing behind the scenes. ✅
[hr][/hr]
🛠️ Here's a summary of what's included in patch 1.0.2:
- Fixed an issue that caused particle effects to float in air
- Fixed typos
- Fixed an interaction on Fuxia that caused an unintentionally repeatable game state
- Fixed achievements from demo to be triggered in full game
- Fixed an achievement from unintentionally triggering in credits
- Fixed some visual glitches
- Changed: game no longer pauses when out of focus while playing in windowed mode
[hr][/hr]

As always, please keep your feedback coming in Elroy's Steam Discussions forum! ❤️

Love,

- Team Elroy

[previewyoutube=bDjgjdN0j0w;full][/previewyoutube]

/Team Elroy

notes.title: When Release?
notes.notes:
Hello dear friends!

The year is coming to an end and some of you might be wondering where we are with Elroy.

Well, we're extremely proud to announce that we are sailing into the holidays with the game feature, story, puzzle and voice-over COMPLETE!

Here is a glimpse behind the scenes featuring our amazing actors recording the voices for Elroy and the Aliens. Featured in this video are 4 of our 20+ actors for Elroy's 60+ characters.

[previewyoutube=d3vEgEdzZM4;full][/previewyoutube]

In order of appearance: Adam Longworth as Wanderbrust, Jay Rincon as Elroy, Dev Joshi as Peggie & Penelope Rawlins as Nikki.

Directed by: the great Mark Estdale at the OMUK studios.

We'll continue in 2024 with polishing, QA-ing, translating and preparing the game for the release in Q4.

Have a wonderful holiday time! :)

We wish you all a lot of love, happiness and peace on Earth. <3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790167/ce62f6977064440920ba2fb0ba015d3016c3c321.jpg

Sincerely, 
Team Elroy
